title: A repository's host and its OWNER/NAME are split inline beside release_repo_host: release_run_artifacts, default_tap, the candidate pick and the cut's refusal
body: Found by CRITIC-4 on ST0011 WP02b-1 (its W2): release_run_artifacts (lib/release.steps) and default_tap (lib/cmd/formula) split HOST/OWNER/NAME inline beside release_repo_host, and release_candidate_pick and cut_run's pre-flight refusal each take OWNER/NAME inline; fix: both ask release_repo_host, and one helper gives OWNER/NAME to all four. After the release, no work before it.
